chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'Adhere to those with large hips, for they are the most child-bearing.'
ai.seo_question: What physical characteristic indicates a woman is more likely to bear many children according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) advises selecting spouses with 'dhawāt al-awrāk' (those with broad hips or thighs), linking this physical trait to greater fertility and ease of childbirth. This reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of valuing physical attributes that facilitate reproductive health and maternal well-being in marital selection, emphasizing practical considerations for family continuity.
